description: Fetch one catalog publisher record by its AT-URI. This is an anonymous catalog read served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables; it is never handled by HappyView.

uri.description: AT-URI of a net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.publisher record. A URI from another collection is rejected rather than looked up.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The uri is missing, malformed, or not a publisher record URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No catalog publisher has that URI.
